title: AI sell-off sends ₹38,971 crore into India
takeaways: Semiconductor index dropped about 12%; Nvidia about 9.3%.
FPIs bought $1.6 billion of Indian shares in one day.
₹38,971 crore of FPI inflows in a week; Nifty up 7.58%.
AI stocks at 23x forward earnings vs 13x for non-AI.
source_note: Sources: Univest, 6 Nov 2026; Investing.com, 6 Nov 2026; ANI/NSDL, 8 Nov 2026; Jefferies via Outlook Money
